metadata.title: Monochromatic Red Portrait with Aggressive Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, monochromatic red portrait featuring a central figure with a hand gesture, topped by heavy block-style display type and aggressive script.
excludeWhen: soft or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, extreme close-up of a male face bathed in intense red light against a black background. A hand is positioned vertically in front of the face, with a finger pointing upward. The top of the frame features two layers of text: a large, geometric block title with a thick outline and a smaller, jagged hand-written script underneath.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic red lighting defines all facial contours and textures
Vertical hand gesture bisects the facial features
Heavy block typography anchors the top center of the composition
High contrast between deep blacks and saturated reds creates depth
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up framing of the face
Dual-style typography (block and script) at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered, filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the vertical finger in the center of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large block title at the top, down the vertical line of the finger to the eyes, then to the lower hand and clothing textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows surrounding the head and in the background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds with extreme value contrast against black.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, squared-off block forms with internal cutouts
Secondary text uses aggressive, sharp, hand-drawn strokes
Primary text features a double outline (inner red, outer cyan)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final letter of the primary word extends into a sharp, horizontal chevron shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric block contrasted with organic, aggressive script.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory sticker in bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy block foundation for the display text.
Matches the aggressive hand-drawn feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a man with a hand gesture in front of his face, rendered entirely in high-contrast monochromatic red and black lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy geometric block title at the top center with a cyan outline, and a jagged red script subtitle immediately below it.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic red and black?
Is the display text heavy, geometric, and outlined?
Is the portrait an extreme close-up with dramatic shadows?

adjustableVariables: Aggression level of the script font
mustRedesign: Standard serif or sans-serif body fonts
postGenerationChecks: Verify the blocky nature of the top text
Ensure the hand gesture does not obscure the eyes completely
Confirm the presence of the cyan accent outline
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Red + Extreme Close-up + Dual-Style Aggressive Typography
